characters.name: In General
characters.description: Flat Character: With the exceptions of Suzi and Buttsquat, most of the Sunnysmiles are extremely one-note, having next-to-no personality outside of being condescending jerks. Light Is Not Good: Sunnysmiles is a bright, high-tech camp full ofJerkassesrun by a tyrannic Buttsquat.

characters.name: Mc Gee
characters.description: The protagonist. A reckless and enthusiastic 12-year-old thrill-seeker who views Camp Lakebottom as a place of fun and adventure. Anime Hair: His hair seems naturally spiky. Annoying Younger Sibling:McGee'sprankstertraits probably made him an example to Suzi, but he's otherwise always ready to stick up for, and help his older sister.She rarely reciprocates. Berserk Button: Don't call Camp Lakebottom lame and don't mess with his friends or the counselors. Butt-Monkey: Things tend to not go his way quite often, although he usually manages to come out in once piece by the end.

characters.name: Gretchen
characters.description: One ofMcGee's two best friends. A sardonic girl who is more than capable on taking the various horrors Camp Lakebottom has to offer. Action Girl: She's trained in martial arts and often puts her skills to use fighting monsters and other freaky things. Affectionate Nickname:McGeeand Squirt sometimes call her "Gretch". Alliterative Name: In "Meet the Gretch's Parents", her surname is revealed to beGrietchelson. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: She has black hair and is noted for her snarky, aloof personality.

characters.name: Squirt
characters.description: The other best friend ofMcGee. A chubby and naive but cheerful boy who can't help but show kindness to all living things. Acrofatic: Despite his rotund appearance, he can be quite nimble when the situation calls for it. The Beastmaster: He'sverygood with animals, being able to befriend and communicate with nearly every wild animal the kids encounter. Big Fun: He isn't slim, but he is a cheerful and kindhearted boy. Catchphrase: "Stop that! You're scaring it," usually when someone is threatening an animal.

characters.name: Sawyer
characters.description: One of the counsellors at Camp Lakebottom. A zombie with a multipurpose tool on his left hand and actually quite a friendly guy - even if his body keeps falling apart. Friendly Zombie: Sawyer is an all roundNice Guywho plays with the kids. While he does snack on brains, which he keeps refrigerated in a fridge, he makes it a strict rule to never harm the campers. His mother on the other hand is a stereotypical brain eating zombie who wants to make her son follow in her path. Handy Man: He serves this role around Camp Lakebottom. HisSwiss-Army Appendageproves useful in that regard. Intergenerational Friendship: With the campers, whom he serves as a sort of father figure to. Meaningful Name: Sawyer is frequently equipped with asawon his left hand.

characters.name: Rosebud
characters.description: Another of Camp Lakebottom's counsellors. A short, stout, and surly old woman with a German accent who cooks up Camp Lakebottom's disgusting meals. Action Girl: She's quite capable in a fight. Ambiguously Human: She certainly looks human, but with the other counselors being a zombie and a Sasquatch, some people wonder... Apron Matron: She's tough-as-nails and looks after the campers like they were her own children. Brawn Hilda: Especially in flashbacks to when she was young. She even sported pigtails and a horned helmet.

characters.name: Armand
characters.description: The last of Camp Lakebottom's counsellors. A sensitive and sophisticated sasquatch with a passion for the performing arts and fashion. Bigfoot, Sasquatch, and Yeti: He's a large brown-furred Bigfoot. Camp Straight: His interests include typically feminine fare like art and fashion, but he has shown interest in women sometimes. Cute Little Fangs: Has tiny fangs visible from his jaw even when his mouth is closed that surprisingly add to his soft personality. Gentle Giant: He's ratherCamp Straight, for a sasquatch.

characters.name: Suzi
characters.description: McGee's older sister and a former pageant queen. She is a vain and spoiled girl who attends Camp Lakebottom's rival, Camp Sunnysmiles. All Girls Want Bad Boys: She has a crush on the obnoxious and arrogant Buttsquat. Aloof Big Sister: ToMcGee, whom she generally showed very little compassion or sympathy towards. Alpha Bitch: A summer camp version. She's vain, spoiled, bossy, always wants to be the center of attention, and hangs out with all the rich, popular kids at Camp Sunnysmiles. Always Someone Better: To Gretchen since she won the Miss Sunnysmile pageant while Gretchen was runner up.

characters.name: Jordan Buttsquat
characters.description: The archrival ofMcGeeand his friends, as well as Suzi's crush. He is the smug and spoiled son of the owner of Camp Sunnysmiles. Alpha Bitch: Male version. The most popular guy in Sunny Smiles and definitely not nice. Arch-Enemy: ToMcGee. Their rivalry is the driving force of many episodes' conflicts. Attention Whore: He's always seeking to be the center of attention in some way. The Caligula: Being the son of the owner of Camp Sunnysmiles means that he pretty much runs the show and there's no stopping his tyranny. He even went as far as to ban gum from the camp.
